summary: Hallador Energy Company filed an 8-K on May 1, 2026, reporting the Board's creation of a new standing Risk Committee and the appointment of Daniel Hudson as Chair. Hudson will receive an additional $25,000 annual retainer for this role, on top of the standard $200,000 non-employee director retainer. The committee will oversee enterprise risk management, including strategic, operational, financial, market, and cybersecurity risks. This is a routine governance enhancement, not a forced or abrupt executive departure. No other special-situation details were provided.
